scope: Change kind hmi_text_list_import through change_prepare/change_apply/change_restore on a qualification Host (--hmi-text-list-qualification <profile>), frozen artifacts/fw3g = a84d2a53, run artifacts/tx3, for unified-comfort (MTP700 Unified Comfort 21.0.1.0) and unified-pc (WinCC Unified PC RT 21.0.1.0). Per profile: HmiSeeder textlist-fixture created and archived an owned seeded fixture (two screens with items, a tag, start screen, a discrete alarm, a Loaded script, the bilingual peer list, en-US/de-DE enabled for runtime); the production Host retrieved an owned copy. Refusals before any write: four actual prior records with content V21 changes (HmiTextListValueOutOfRange, HmiTextListNameUnsupported, HmiTextListTextUnsupported, HmiTextListDefaultEntryValue), an author record with outputId, an unknown record, a client-supplied candidate, an unknown set output, and a candidate missing a project language (HmiTextListLanguageMismatch). Nine imports in order (boundary values, texts and names, the v1 base replacing the peer list, the retained v2 author, the retained v3 author replacing it, both outputs of a retained v1 set, reordered languages): each prepared with the StaleRevision-bound content hash, applied with checkpoint, device compile and save, worker readback exact, the independent PyYAML oracle on hmi_inspect's export exact with every other list unchanged, same-key replay returning the recorded outcome and another key refused RecoveryRequired; a preview prepared before another saved import refused StaleRevision and left prepared; every typed HMI node outside the text lists unchanged; change_restore of the last import with HMI content equality and the previous lists; a fresh Host and owned TIA reopening the saved original with the last lists and unchanged typed nodes. 168 checks, no failures.
limitations: Owned seeded fixtures only, one Unified HMI per project, en-US/de-DE both enabled for runtime; other devices, languages, customer projects, consumers of the imported lists, runtime and visual behavior were not run.
Compiler problems are compared by state, text and path; the fixtures keep their two encrypted-transfer password errors (no public setter), so no clean compile is shown.
A project language not enabled for runtime is refused (V21 throws from HmiLanguageAndFont.Order); formatted and system text lists, graphic lists and script modules are not imported.
